question.text: Which of the following mixing of 1 M base and 1 M acid leads to the largest increase in temperature?

solution.text:
The rise in temperature of neutralization reaction will be maximum for maximum number of moles of strong acid and strong base neutralized and lower volume of final solution.
(3) $\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{NaOH} \rightarrow \mathrm{NaCl}+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$
mmol $30 \quad 30$
Final volume of solution $=60 \mathrm{~mL}$
Option (1) and (2) have weak acids and in option
(4) only 20 mmol of HCl will be neutralized with 70 mL final volume.
